tools.name: find_fit_candidates
tools.description: Pre-adoption decision tool for open-source reuse. Call BEFORE implementing non-trivial functionality that a maintained OSS component could provide (queue, scheduler, parser, auth, cache, protocol client, ...) or before adding a dependency. Send a short capability need plus your project's minimal con
